description: This file defines LLDB debugger extensions for PyTorch, including custom summary providers and commands to enhance debugging experience of PyTorch tensor types and related objects.

classes.name: DisableBreakpoints
classes.description: A context manager to temporarily disable all breakpoints in LLDB to prevent hitting breakpoints during evaluation, ensuring safe inspection of objects.

methods.name: Any get_target()
methods.description: Retrieve the current LLDB target, or print an error if unavailable.

methods.name: str IntArrayRef_summary(valobj: Any, internal_dict: Any, options: Any)
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string summary for c10::IntArrayRef objects in LLDB.

methods.name: str DispatchKeyset_summary(valobj: Any, internal_dict: Any, options: Any)
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string summary for c10::DispatchKeyset objects in LLDB.

methods.name: str Tensor_summary(valobj: Any, internal_dict: Any, options: Any)
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string summary for at::Tensor objects in LLDB by invoking Python representations through evaluated expressions.

methods.name: Any __lldb_init_module(debugger: Any, internal_dict: Any)
methods.description: Initializes LLDB with custom type summaries for PyTorch types, enabling enhanced debugging display.

methods.name: None __exit__(self, etype: Any, evalue: Any, tb: Any)
